report:
Inserts spaces when pasting text in the browser

### Description

When I paste text into the browser, the text is entered line by line with a tab stop.

### Screenshots

![example](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/assets/95724863/c411427d-6612-4fd6-93ad-61fb2303a59c)

Example Gitea demo site:
![example_site_demo](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/assets/95724863/24995ae6-b495-4e49-a17e-e4cc928dac28)

### Gitea Version

Versión: 1.21.0

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

Yes

### Operating System

KDE neon 5.27

### Browser Version

Firefox 123.0 (64-bit)

evidence.quote: Maybe this is something about your browser or its extensions. Try disabling browser extensions and test again. If it still fails with all extensions disabled, report it to https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor.

confirmation.quote: Oh my god, I have tried with chromium and the error does not appear!

notes: Reporter reproduced the same paste behaviour in the standalone Monaco editor playground (outside Gitea) and it disappears in Chromium; issue closed by reporter with upstream report microsoft/monaco-editor#4397, no Gitea code change -> browser/upstream editor (A), not misuse (B), deployment (C) or Gitea defect (D).
